original_ko: 블랙박스를 열어봤을 때, 저는 이미 답을 알고 있었습니다. 매일, 같은 시간, 같은 오피스텔.
proposed_en: When I opened the dashcam, I already knew the answer. Every day, same time, same studio apartment.
risk: Low. EN keeps "same studio apartment" — surface vocab — and never names the resident. "I already knew the answer" mirrors KO ambiguity (A's S0 frame: "it must be an affair") without stating it as fact.
recommendation: Acceptable. Confirm the EN reader receives the same ambiguity (still possible to be wrong about the cause).

proposed_en: That… I'm the one who bought them.
risk: None on this line in isolation. Risk emerges if a translator pads the sentence with context ("I bought them for someone else") that hints at recipient.
recommendation: Hold the EN line as terse as the KO line. Do not add ""for"" clauses at lieBand=early.

original_ko: 이준호 씨, 퇴근 후 오피스텔 방문과 새벽 통화는 본인 행동입니다.
proposed_en: Mr. Lee, the after-work studio-apartment visits and the late-night calls are your own actions.
risk: Low. The judge restricts to surface actions (visits, calls) and never names a recipient or claim of affair / claim of family. Same boundary as KO.
recommendation: Acceptable. Verify EN reviewer that ""studio apartment"" reads neutral (not affair-coded).

original_ko: 박지연 씨의 외도 주장과 이준호 씨 설명이 가장 크게 어긋나는 사실이 무엇입니까.
proposed_en: Where does Mrs. Park's claim of an affair diverge most sharply from your account?
risk: Medium. Naming "claim of an affair" in the judge channel is allowed because A has already framed the case publicly — the judge is referring to A's claim, not asserting it. EN "claim of an affair" preserves this attribution.
recommendation: Acceptable. Reviewer confirm that EN reads as ""A's framing"" not as the judge's assertion.

original_ko: 제가 직접 한 행동은 오피스텔 방문, 새벽 통화, 영수증 물건 안에서 자료로 확인되는 부분부터 답하겠습니다.
proposed_en: As for what I did myself — the studio visits, the late-night calls, the receipted items — I'll start with the parts the records can confirm.
risk: Low. B at S0 enumerates surface actions and refuses inference. EN matches.

original_ko: 결혼 10년차 부부 박지연·이준호. 8개월째 각방을 쓰고 있다. 아내 박지연이 남편의 딴살림을 주장하며 재판을 신청했다.
proposed_en: Park Ji-yeon and Lee Jun-ho, married ten years. They've been sleeping in separate rooms for eight months. The wife, Park Ji-yeon, filed for trial, claiming her husband is keeping a second household.
risk: Low. "Claiming her husband is keeping a second household" preserves attribution (claim, not fact). KO 딴살림 = "separate household" with affair connotation; EN "second household" is the closest faithful match.
recommendation: Acceptable. Reviewer confirm that ""second household"" does not over-read as affair (KO 딴살림 leans affair; EN ""second household"" is more neutral). Acceptable for opening because A's framing is meant to be loaded.

original_ko: 블랙박스를 확인해 보고, 매일 같은 오피스텔에 두세 시간씩 방문하는 것을 알게 되었습니다.
proposed_en: I checked the dashcam and learned he was visiting the same studio apartment every day for two or three hours at a time.
risk: Low. Surface fact only. Names a place type (studio apartment) without naming any resident.

original_ko: 자기야 뭐가 오해인데? 매일같이 거기를 다녀와놓고 그저 오해라고? 거기서 뭘 하는 건데?
proposed_en: Honey, what is the misunderstanding? You go there every single day and call it just a misunderstanding? What are you doing there?
risk: Low. A is pressing without naming anyone. EN preserves the question without forcing inference.

proposed_en: Convenience store, bookshop — those are all things I bought.
risk: Risk: "bookshop" specifies bookstore. KO 서점 = bookstore. Concern: bookstore implies study materials and could be read by a sharp EN player as "this man is buying study supplies for a child" earlier than the KO line allows.
recommendation: Acceptable but watch. KO source already uses 서점 — EN translation is faithful. The leak risk is the SAME as KO. If the KO writer wanted to obscure further, they would have used 매장 / 가게. Translator must not obscure beyond KO.

original_ko: … 외도 해석과 분리해 시간순으로 답하게 한다. 친형·조카 정체는 S5 전 직접 언급 금지.
risk: behaviorHint contains the truth tokens 친형·조카. Risk: if behaviorHint is ever surfaced (debug overlay / future tooling) and translated, EN translator could leak "older brother" / "nephew" inadvertently.
recommendation: Lock behaviorHint as Korean-only writer note. Do not translate. If the team later wants EN behaviorHints, the EN side should also encode the truth tokens behind the same disclosure boundary — they are NEVER user-visible regardless of locale.

proposed_en: (Truth label) brother's text thread — this is the truth field, not the surface label.
risk: Critical. evidence.e-4.name is the ground-truth label and is read by the disclosure guard's surfaceMap to detect leaks. If EN localization mirrors this field as "brother's text thread" and a UI surface accidentally renders evidence.name (instead of evidence.surfaceName), the EN player sees the truth before S5.
recommendation: DO NOT translate evidence.name in this pass. Translate only evidence.surfaceName (= "text from an unknown sender"). Add a UI audit step that confirms no panel renders evidence.name directly. If EN must mirror evidence.name for disclosure-guard parity, add it to the EN forbidden-lexeme set.

original_ko: ...이준호 씨에게 직접 추궁하시거나 형 문자(e-4)를 제시하면 구체적 사연이...
proposed_en: (Truth-bearing version) ...if you press Mr. Lee directly or present the brother's text (e-4), the specifics will…
risk: Critical. The disclosure-policy.md §4.1 uiSurfaceMap table already replaces this with the surface form: '...해당 문자 기록(e-4)을 제시하면 숨긴 사정이...'. EN must take the surface form, NOT the truth form, as source.
recommendation: Source for EN translation must be uiSurfaceMap's surface text, not the raw KO truth string in evidence.name / judgeHint. Recommend extracting EN translation source from disclosurePolicy/spouse-01 surface map (Codex JSON) once it lands, OR mark explicit "en source = surface" rule per field.

original_ko: 외도가 아닙니다. 형의 오피스텔에서 조카를 돌봤습니다. 새벽 전화도 형과의 긴급 연락이었습니다.
proposed_en: It wasn't an affair. I was looking after my nephew at my older brother's studio apartment. The late-night calls were emergency contacts with my brother.
risk: Acceptable risk. This is the S5 confession — by definition, full truth disclosure is allowed here. EN must reveal at the same moment as KO (not earlier and not later).
recommendation: Acceptable for the S5 confession entry only. Verify EN translator does NOT leak this content into earlier S0–S2 variants in interrogation_answers.

original_ko: 그 전화는 그냥… 아니, 그 시간에 올 수밖에 없는 연락이었습니다. 제가 왜 받았는지는 따로 설명하겠습니다.
proposed_en: That call — well, no, it was a contact that could only have come at that hour. I'll explain separately why I picked it up.
risk: Low. The interjection adds an angle (call_record) without naming the caller. EN preserves the same hedge.

original_ko: 제 개인 비자금 3,000만원 출금과 아내의 공동 적금 해지 문제는 따로 구분해서 정리해 주시기 바랍니다.
proposed_en: please keep my 30-million-won personal slush-fund withdrawal and my wife's joint savings cancellation as two separate matters.
risk: Low–Medium. Mediation phase is post-S5 by gameplay convention; truth lexemes are allowed here. EN "personal slush-fund withdrawal" preserves the slightly self-incriminating register.
recommendation: Acceptable. Confirm with reviewer that ""slush fund"" reads as B's chosen word (a partial admission) rather than the judge's framing.

original_ko: 반복 추궁은 닫힌 문만 두드린다. 방향을 바꿔라.
proposed_en: Repeating the same press only knocks on a closed door. Change direction.
risk: None. System message; no truth content.
